About the Hiring Team
Welcome to Lightspeed LA, the first U.S.-based, AAA game development studio for Tencent Games. Lightspeed LA is focused on building open-world games that emphasize an ambitious living world, sophisticated player-driven gameplay, and mature, thoughtful storytelling. We are developing the first in a series of genre-defining titles.
Why join Lightspeed LA?
For us, it's not only about the exciting, new AAA open world game we're developing but also about team values and studio culture. We foster an open and transparent environment where everyone feels comfortable providing constructive feedback about all aspects of our games.
●	We encourage the showing of work that's still in progress.
●	We don't attack or question unfinished work, we celebrate its promise.
●	We have a No Blame Culture where we blame the problem, not the person.
This is a safe place to fail, and we don't view failure as a negative, but as the natural result of pushing boundaries and trying new things. We create together. We face Challenges Together. We succeed together.

What the Role Entails
LightSpeed LA is seeking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Graphics Engineer to join our new studio in sunny Irvine California. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for games and enabling content creators to deliver the most polished experience for our players. Join our team of industry veterans and help us build a team and culture of respect that pushes boundaries while having lots of fun.
Responsibilities:
Help maintain a culture of fast iteration and practical problem solving
Design and program low level graphics engine components
Evolve iteratively existing systems into state of the art solutions
Mentor others to make the best use of engine systems and hardware capabilities

Who We Look For
Passion for games and the technology that makes them come to life
Excellent 3D math skills
Deep understanding of modern rendering techniques, graphics hardware and rendering APIs
Strong understanding of game content pipeline and tools
10+ years of professional experience with C++ programming in the game industry
Shipped at least one game title on PC and Consoles as a graphics engineer
Expert C++ and HLSL knowledge and debugging skills
Excellent understanding of PC and console hardware bottlenecks and optimization strategies
Deep understanding of multithreaded programming
Value lean, simple, efficient, well-tested code
Comfortable maintaining existing large codebase for multiple platforms
Team player who works closely with other engineers to make sure our technology provides reliable and fast iteration for our content creators, and a fluid experience for our customers
Preferred: 
Experience building AAA engine(s)
Experience with CUDA or similar
Experience with dynamic GI solution and hardware RT

Why Join Us?

Just some of the benefits of working with us here at our newly built studio in Irvine, CA. 
● Free daily lunch

Shipped at least one AAA PC or console title as Technical Director or Lead Engineer.
Proven experience leading and evaluating global co-development teams.
Demonstrated experience architecting large-scale systems, including third-party integrations.
Experience defining and maintaining performance budgets, stability targets, and scalability goals.
Broad technical foundation across gameplay systems, engine development, rendering, AI, networking, or cloud infrastructure.
Deep expertise in at least one core technical domain.
Proven ability to align cross-discipline leadership and drive execution through ambiguity.
Player-focused mindset grounded in measurable quality outcomes.

Delivered or operated a multiplayer FPS at 100k+ peak concurrency.

Background in engineering, computer science, or related field.

       Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.
       The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.

Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.

Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.
Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.
Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.
Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.
Stakeholder Engagement

Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.
Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

0 – 3 years of relevant professional experience.
